statement: You receive a row of integers in which every value appears exactly twice, apart from one value that appears once. Find that value in a single pass with constant extra memory: XOR all the values together. The pairs cancel to zero and the fold ends holding the single value. Print it.
constraints: Exactly one value appears once; all others appear exactly twice.

example.why: 1 XOR 1 and 2 XOR 2 both vanish, leaving only the 4 in the accumulator.

hint: Start the accumulator at zero - the identity element - and fold the whole row through it.
mistake: Reaching for a hash map of counts; it works but spends the linear memory the task explicitly rules out.
